answer_1.quote: Our goal is to assess the capability of state-of-the-art ST systems to properly translate NEs and terminology present in an utterance... the direct model ... maps the audio into target language text bypassing any intermediate symbolic representation.
answer_1.outputs: translated text generated from speech (speech-to-text translation)

answer_2.quote: BLEU scores are on par for en-es and en-it... We compute NE/term accuracy as the ratio of entities that are present in the systems' output in the correct form... The WER of the ASR is similar across the three language directions.
